what: Three layers of blurred accent-color waves (16px × 1.2·1·.8) undulate along the section floor — the 1440 base width is extended by 18% margins on each side and divided into nine points, each point adds two sines with random phase (.62·.38 ratio, the second 1.62× faster), and the resulting heights are joined with a Catmull-Rom curve. Back layer (wave 400 · opacity .6 · speed .5), middle (300 · .75 · .6), front (150, sway ±80 · 1 · .7). The 200px base (250px at 600px and below) is fully filled, with the accent fading .5 → 0 going up. Drawn only while visible

options.base: Height of the fully filled base (px), default 200
options.base-sm: Base plate at 600px or below (px), default 250

note: The element is laid as a base pattern filling its parent (absolute · inset 0 · z-index 0) — text above it has a raised z-index. With reduced motion it stops at the 0s state.

from.where: shared.js closing CTA wave (original #brandWaveBg — 3 layers · 8 dot cells · 18% margin · base plate 200/250 · 16px blur)
